purpose: Sign-in, sign-up and account recovery screens: a titled form with one primary action, recovery links and an optional alternative such as single sign-on.

props.name: variant
props.description: centred (default) puts the form on a panel over the sunken page; split adds an aside panel for reassurance or brand content

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo or product name, above the form

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one primary button, type submit

props.name: secondaryActions
props.description: Links such as Forgot your password?

props.name: alternative
props.description: Another way in, such as single sign-on, after an or divider

props.name: aside
props.description: Split variant only: reassurance or brand content

props.name: asideLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the aside; defaults to About your account

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called on submit; the page does not reload

whenToUse: Sign in, sign up, forgot password, reset password and check-your-email screens
split when there is reassurance or brand content worth the space, such as security cues for banking
whenNotToUse: Forms after sign-in, such as profile or checkout — use FormPage
A sign-in prompt inside a page — use a Modal
antiPatterns: Error messages that reveal whether an account exists
Hiding account recovery behind a menu

sizes: Form column `size-container-sm`; panels wrap below two `size-modal-md` widths; gaps `space-component-gap-md`, `space-layout-section`

a11yNotes: One main landmark; the form is named by the h1
The aside is a named complementary landmark
Fields come first in source order, so keyboard and screen reader users reach them before the aside

slots.name: title
slots.description: Says what the page does, in sentence case. Example: Sign in. Up to about 30 characters.

slots.name: description
slots.description: One sentence on which account to use. Example: Use the email address registered to your business account. Up to 140 characters.

slots.name: form
slots.description: The fields, each with a visible label. Sign-in: email and password, then Keep me signed in if offered.

slots.name: secondaryActions
slots.description: Recovery links. Example: Forgot your password?

slots.name: primaryAction
slots.description: One contained button that says what happens. Example: Sign in. Never Submit.

slots.name: alternative
slots.description: Another way in, outlined, after or. Example: Sign in with single sign-on.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Legal links: privacy notice, terms, accessibility.

slots.name: aside
slots.description: Split only. Reassurance in plain words, such as how to spot a genuine request.
